what: A pool answer with feats null/str/list-of-str was cached and then crashed read_entity on every later pass.
how: Added _feats_ok (list of dict rows with str/None sentence and axis); read_entity treats a malformed answer as unanswered and never caches it; _chunk_get treats a malformed cached body as a miss.

what: survey(None) ignored weave_index.LAST_UNREADABLE so a torn record dropped a source from THREADS.json silently.
how: survey() raises ThreadRefused when a whole-corpus load left unreadable records; main() already prints ThreadRefused as a REFUSING line. Injected-records callers (drill fixtures) are unaffected.

what: why_missed text in data/HANDBUILT_ASSAYS.json now contradicts the live records for five sheets.
how: Assay prose / curatorial wording, not code (open OWNER order cd77e492b26b covers handbuilt wording). Options: re-derive each reason from live records at compute() time; date-stamp each reason; or owner rewrites the five strings and the header. Also unverified: machine assay and hand-built assay may now coexist for the same entity, needs a reconciliation ruling.

what: Dispatch caught only (TypeError, ValueError), so a non-string argument ended run() and lost patches/unreverted alarms.
how: Dispatch now catches Exception and returns the same {error: ...} dict.

what: ensure_transport pinned False for the life of a --loop process after one transient CB.engine() failure.
how: New keyword reprobe=False (signature-compatible); run() calls ensure_transport(reprobe=True) once per pass, re-deciding a cached False before workers start. Hot path and cached True unchanged.

what: _b32 looped forever on a negative address.
how: _b32 raises ValueError for n < 0 (root cause, covers encode and any other caller).

what: Unreadable TIERS.json gave every world a wrong-but-valid address, noted only.
how: build_all raises RuntimeError (REFUSING TO PROFILE) when TIERS.json is unreadable, after the note. Per-source missing rows (charted-gap case) unchanged. Only callers: main() and verify_math import-time build_all(limit=400), which read a live readable TIERS.json.

what: annex_codes/law_codes raised AttributeError when `declared` was not an object.
how: New _declared(doc,key) helper returns None for a non-dict declared; both functions use it.

what: splitlines() numbered lines differently from editors/ast (NEL, U+2028, FF, ...), latent shift of citation resolution.
how: New _split_lines splits on CRLF/CR/LF only and drops the trailing empty element; used by _lines and citations_in_text.

what: Torn-tree fingerprint hashed .py only, so prompts/ was never fingerprinted.
how: _tree_fingerprint now also digests every non-.py file under each root (skipping __pycache__/.git; None on OSError). codewatch.fingerprint still used for .py.

what: Stale '61 MB' figure in comment (file is ~80 MB); handbuilt.py:284 comment also stale.
how: read.py comment now says 'tens of MB' (no figure to rot). handbuilt.py:284 left: it sits in the same curatorial text as F3 and belongs with the owner's handbuilt wording ruling.

what: Undertaker suasion cited text still says 'THE HIGHEST-EARNED SCORE IN THIS LIBRARY' for 9.9, tied with his continuity 9.9.
how: Superlative wording in assay prose: covered by open OWNER order cd77e492b26b; not changed.

what: _gate keeps the wide 'cloud' regime if tuning.regime() raises.
how: Likely deliberate fail-open for throughput, but it should be fail-narrow. Options: default to the narrow local gate on exception, or keep and escalate the note. Not changed.
Options: stop the loop on not ok, or back off and re-loop. Behavior/policy choice.

what: A failed /api/tags probe caches the 18.6 GB configured model for the process life (carried).
how: Options: do not cache a failed-probe fallback, or cache with a short TTL.

what: _self_citation_ok is constant False so the branch at :359 cannot fire.
how: Options: delete the hook and branch (deletion, so left for a ruling) or implement the exemption. Not changed.

what: QUOTED_TAG exemption lets a genuine pointer written in quotes hide a rotted citation.
how: Options: keep (measured 21 of 21 mentions), or check quoted pointers that resolve to a real file. Design decision.

what: Text-mode rewrite of an LF file under prompts/ or handoff/ would come back CRLF on revert (carried).
how: Options: read/write bytes in text mode, or refuse text-mode for revert. Changes write semantics of the gate, so left for a ruling.
